events.title: Cellar Sessions Open Mic Comedy
events.description: An intimate open mic night where local comedians test new material in the basement of The Raven Hotel. It offers a raw, unfiltered look at the local stand-up scene in a social, dive-bar atmosphere.

events.title: Open Mic Comedy Night
events.description: A casual, free entry comedy night at the Newmarket Hotel featuring a mix of amateur comics. A great spot for a low-pressure social evening to see new creative talent in Brisbane.

events.title: Esoteric Wisdom of the Caduceus Lecture
events.description: A talk exploring the historical and symbolic significance of the Caduceus within esoteric traditions. Hosted by the Theosophical Society, this event is designed for those interested in philosophy, comparative religion, and intellectual inquiry.
